description: This file defines a report for procurement tracking in an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch and process procurement data, and map related records such as material requests, purchase invoices, and receipts.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the procurement tracker report.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles procurement data for the report.

methods.name: get_mapped_mr_details
methods.description: Retrieves and maps material request details from the database.

methods.name: get_mapped_pi_records
methods.description: Retrieves purchase invoice records linked to purchase orders.

methods.name: get_mapped_pr_records
methods.description: Retrieves purchase receipt records linked to purchase orders.

methods.name: get_po_entries
methods.description: Fetches purchase order entries based on conditions.
